piśācādikṛtarogaḥ पिशाचादिकृतरोगः
Diseases caused by malevolent or negative spiritual entities

.36 piśitāśritaṃpaṭalam पिशिताश्रितंपटलम्
Iris and uveal tract

ITA-5.66.54 piṣṭakaḥ पिष्टकः
Lymphangioma
A disorder characterized by raised lesions resembling waterdrops; raised growth like rice-paste; rounded.

ITA-5.41.15 piṣṭamehaḥ पिष्टमेहः
Polyuria disorder with urine resembling flour mixed with water
A disorder characterized by floury white urination; bristling during micturition; profuse urination; whitish urination.
